items.title: Jon Hassell :: Music Is Invisible (Pentimento Volume Three)
items.summary: Music Is Invisible marks the third and final entry in Jon Hassell's Pentimento trilogy. Arriving five years after the experimental trumpeter's death, it's not exactly a studio album, but it's more than a live tape. As a record of a singular artist's psychic terroir, strong, mutable style and idiosyncratic sonic palette, it's a fittingly puzzling send-off.
